about: Known differences between what coding agents (Claude Code, Codex with a shell) and the in-editor agent (MCP tools only) can do. checked by scripts/check-agent-parity.mjs; see docs/standards/agent-surface-parity.md. Gaps are reported on every run until a tool closes them; an entry that no longer matches its skill fails the check.

coding_agent_skills.device-format-coverage: Checks media pipeline changes against synthetic device fixtures and updates the coverage registry; repository development only.
coding_agent_skills.editor-ui-design: Changes editor source code; repository development only.
coding_agent_skills.session-retro: Reviews coding-agent session transcripts in the repository; contributor work, not editing.
coding_agent_skills.music-catalog-ingestion: Maintains the shared music catalog files and analysis environment.
coding_agent_skills.dreamcut-rendering: Renderer integration work in the repository.
coding_agent_skills.performance-review: Measures and changes repository code for speed; repository development only.
coding_agent_skills.platform-video-delivery: Export runs only on an explicit creator request; the editor's Export button is the creator's path and no agent export tool exists.
coding_agent_skills.pr-review: Pull request review in the repository.
coding_agent_skills.recreate-effect: Builds new effect capabilities in source code.
coding_agent_skills.tutorial-screen-recording: Captures the screen with a shell command and drives the built-in browser; the in-editor agent has neither.
coding_agent_skills.windows-compatibility: Validates the source install in a disposable Windows VM; repository development, not a working-timeline editing operation.
coding_agent_skills.releasing: Checks a push to the public repository for the owner; repository development only.
coding_agent_skills.install-check: Checks the source install and feature setup in disposable folders; repository development only.

gaps.missing: Tool to persist an editorial intent plan
gaps.reason: Writing the plan file needs filesystem access the in-editor agent does not have.
The layer builder is a repository script.

gaps.missing: MCP coverage of the analysis job and annotation routes
gaps.reason: The skill points at HTTP routes; the in-editor agent reaches analysis only through visual_analyze and media_readiness.
The in-editor agent can inspect frames only after proposing (run_instrument frame-state on the proposal, then timeline_evidence).

gaps.missing: Effect primitive verification as a tool
gaps.reason: Repository verification script used when effect code changes.
Repository script; the in-editor agent can review cutouts only through visual_analyze.

gaps.missing: Reference record validation as a tool
gaps.reason: Repository validator for effect reference records.

gaps.missing: Tool to render a proposal preview to a video file
gaps.reason: Rendering a card's preview to MP4 is a repository script; the in-editor agent replays the card in the editor instead.

gaps.missing: Shared catalog privacy check as a tool
gaps.reason: Only shared catalog changes in the repository run it; a Yours card stays in the creator's profile.

gaps.missing: Shared effect catalog validation as a tool
gaps.reason: Shared cards are repository files, which the in-editor agent does not change.

gaps.missing: run_instrument frame-state with --proposal-file and --option (it refuses proposal files today)
gaps.reason: Checking a graded face on a pending card needs the card rendered as it would apply; timeline_evidence can show such a report but nothing on the MCP surface makes one. Recorded from the 2026-10-27 dreamcut-tutorial retro.

gaps.missing: run_instrument frame-state with --proposal-file and --option (it refuses proposal files today)
gaps.reason: Checking a zoom card's mid-ease framing before posting needs the card rendered as it would apply; timeline_evidence can show such a report but nothing on the MCP surface makes one. Recorded from the 2026-10-27 dreamcut-tutorial retro.
